desc: The EVO SP is designed to be the ultimate choice in concealed carry pistols. The EVO SP balances providing all of the necessary features of a true performance grade pistol without the exorbitant price tag. It features factory installed TRUGLO Tritium Pro sights, a smooth and consistent trigger, and match grade deep crown barrel. It also offers a full grip and backstrap set to tailor the pistol to your hand size for ultimate control and comfort.
